messages.en:
{07 00 00}Say,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00} You know
how there are lots of
different kinds of fish?
{07 19 00}Well, there are different
kinds of fishers, too. {01 00 00 0a 00}Take
you, for instance.
You're the hero type. You
swoop in, show off, and
talk big.{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} It's your thing.
{07 14 00}But me, I'm more of a
behind-the-scenes sort of
guy!
{07 13 00}I stay kind of quiet and
don't like showing my face
too much. {01 00 00 0a 00}I work subtly.
Some even call me {ff 00 00 02}rare{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}So, for our next
competition{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}Let's compete to see who
can catch the {ff 00 00 02}rarest{ff 00 00 00} kind
of fish!
